prompt: Typing a name for a saved view above the issue table is laggy. Each keystroke takes a noticeable moment.

truth.summary: selectVisibleIssues is a createSelector whose input selector returns a new { filters, sort } object on every call, so the memoisation never hits: every dispatched action filters and sorts all 3,240 issues and hands IssueTable a new page object.

referenceAnswer.cause: The selectIssueQuery input selector returns a new object each call, so selectVisibleIssues recomputes and returns a new array on every action, including saved-view name keystrokes.

decoyAnswers.cause: The view name is stored in Redux instead of local state.
Rows get an inline onToggle handler.

referenceFix.replace:
const selectIssueFilters = (state: RootState) => state.issues.filters
const selectIssueSort = (state: RootState) => state.issues.sort

genieEvidence.notes: react_get_renders shows IssueTable re-rendering per keystroke, with prop 'rows' changed by reference on the inner class (appOnly:false). The recomputation cost sits in mapStateToProps during the store notification, outside any component render, so Genie's render timings do not show it.
